name: @wizeworks/email-sends
description: Lean, backend-safe email enqueue: writes a ScheduledSend row (suppression-checked) that the api-rest email-dispatch tick later turns into an email.send. NO render/React deps — so backend workers (automation-worker) can enqueue a send without dragging in @wizeworks/email/@wizeworks/ui. @wizeworks/email-platform owns the management surface; this owns only the producer primitive.
